doc.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Bebop and the first American trip
title: Back to Europe for the Nice festival with the Belgian group
summary: He rejoined the Belgian delegation for Nice, with saxophonist Bobby Jaspar.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: So winter of ’47, your first trip to America. You go back. You join up with your Belgian delegation to perform in Nice.

There was just… We weren’t that [unintelligible] as a group. [laughs] But there were good musicians. There was a saxophonist—Bobby Jaspar, and he played… he wound up playing. He came here and played a lot.
In his fifties. Oh, I have an anecdote.
